_doc: One of the grenades Fuze's Cluster Charge lets out (research/operators/fuze.md §3.1; Phase 8 M5): never carried (its `count` is unused), thrown by the charge (data/gadgets/cluster_charge.json `cluster`), bouncing until its fuse ends, the grenades going off in the order they came out. Each: none past 4.2 m, lethal to everyone within 1.2 m and to the 100 hp (1-health) operators within 2 m (Fandom; our curve: 140 to 1.2 m, falling to 0 at 4.2 m, so 103 at 2 m). It destroys gadgets of both teams within its reach (as a frag's reach is its destruction range: the official tip's "all gadgets placed in a defensive stronghold") and drones (any explosion does), and cuts a frag's disc into panels close to it. Its fuse, damage value, destruction range, cut and size are placeholders.
name: Cluster Charge
